title: Create Your First Commit
description: Initialize a Git repository and create your first commit.
hints: Start by initializing Git in the /workspace directory with git init.
After creating README.md, stage it with git add README.md and create a commit with git commit.

intro.message: Hey! I was working on this repo earlier and got pulled away. I think I left things unfinished. Can you take a look?

initializeRepository.message: Nice! The repository is initialized. We're ready to start.

createFile.message: Good. We've got something to work with now.

stageFile.message: Nice, the file is staged. We're almost there.

createCommit.message: There it is! Your first commit is in.

success.message: You did it! You saved me from having to come back and clean this up. I owe you one.

failure.message: Hmm... something's still not quite right. Take another look and give it another shot.
